periods.summary: --- 变量输出格式: rule: - 你必须于下一次回复结束时输出变量更新分析与指令 - 支持: replace, delta, insert, remove, move - 不得更新 _ 前缀的只读变量 format: |- <UpdateVariable> <Analysis>$(IN ENGLISH, no more than 80 words) - ${calculate time passed} - ${decide whether dramatic updates are allowed: yes/no} - ${analyze every variable based on its check} </Analysis> <JSONPatch> [ { "op": "replace", "path": "/path/to/var", "value": new_value }, { "op": "insert", "path": "/path/to/array/-", "value": new_item } ] </JSONPatch> </UpdateVariable>
